intervals.label: proposed (white paper onward)
intervals.locator: arXiv:1409.7741 abstract (26 Sep 2014); arXiv:2209.13357 (2022): planned for Hall A; JLab Hall A update Feb 2026: "Need to obtain DOE CD0"
intervals.note: Status remains `proposed`: five physics proposals are PAC-approved and the project had a successful DOE Science Review in March 2021, but as of the February 2026 Hall A update the project still needed DOE CD-0.
intervals.quote: a new Solenoidal Large Acceptance Device (SoLID) is proposed

placements.note: Planned location only: the detector does not yet exist.
placements.quote: SoLID is intended to be installed in experimental Hall A

summary.plain: A planned large solenoid-based detector for Hall A, built to handle very high rates so that experiments can see rare scattering events in great detail.
summary.technical: Planned SoLID spectrometer: large-acceptance forward scattering device with full azimuthal coverage and a solenoid magnet, configured for SIDIS/J/psi and (with different detectors) for PVDIS at an event rate of 500 kHz.

technology.quote: The planned SoLID detector is a large acceptance forward scattering spectrometer with full azimuthal angular coverage
technology.value: Large-acceptance forward scattering spectrometer with full azimuthal angular coverage, handling luminosities of 10^37-10^39 per cm^2 per second
